g.text: Require >=12uF effective each through bias/temp/aging; >=96uF total conditional.

g.desc: Require >=12uF effective each through bias/temp/aging; >=96uF total conditional.

g.text: This floor is NOT proof of CAN 3.0V minimum during heavy load steps.

g.text: No input bulk added; upstream capacitance/source-impedance budget remains open.

g.text: UVLO / WEAK SOURCE OPEN: operating VINmin4.3V; UVLO rise max4.25V, fall3.8Vtyp.

g.text: No MCU action is required to start essential power.

g.desc: No MCU action is required to start essential power.

g.text: OPEN AUTONOMOUS 3V3 OV CONTAINMENT: failed-short high-side can expose MCU/CAN

g.text: and25V output bank to~35V. Upstream solar OV protection does not contain this fault.

g.desc: #FLG0400 models that passive output. GND fixture remains; actual BMS/RBF and startup/source bounds remain open.
